sloka: यथा स च महाबाहुर्मां तारयति राघवः ।अस्माद्दुःखाम्बुसंरोधात्त्वं समाधातुमर्हसि ।। ५.३९.९।।।।
transliteration: yathā sa ca mahābāhurmāṁ tārayati rāghavaḥ ।asmādduḥkhāmbusaṁrodhāttvaṁ samādhātumarhasi ।। 5.39.9।।।।

translations.english: "You must pacify the strongarmed Rama in a manner by which he will help me to cross the ocean of grief and rlieve me.
